user.title: User
user.description: Registered user profile containing the public RSA public key for End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) key exchange.

publicKey.description: Base64-encoded RSA public key in SPKI format

room.title: Room
room.description: A direct message or group chat room.

name.description: Group name or label, or auto-generated for direct chats

createdBy.description: User ID of the room creator

roomMember.title: Room Member
roomMember.description: A member of a specific room, containing their individual, RSA-encrypted copy of the room's symmetric AES key.

userId.description: Unique user ID of the member

encryptedRoomKey.description: The room's symmetric 256-bit AES-GCM key encrypted with the member's public RSA key (Base64)

joinedAt.description: Timestamp when the member joined the room

message.title: Message
message.description: An end-to-end encrypted message payload containing Base64 encrypted text and its corresponding IV.

iv.description: Base64-encoded AES initial vector (96-bit for GCM)

presence.title: Presence Status
presence.description: Typing and presence states for users inside a room.

isTyping.description: Whether the user is currently typing

/users/{userId}.description: Global collection mapping user IDs to their profile credentials and E2EE public keys.

/rooms/{roomId}/members/{userId}.description: Sub-collection of user memberships in a chat room, defining key distribution mappings securely.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: E2EE encrypted messages in a chat room, completely shielded from third-party server reading.

/rooms/{roomId}/presence/{userId}.description: Real-time presence and typing status map.
